activation.beacon: at least one prefix prediction set is smaller than the full label space

result.split_policy: seeded stratified complete-simulation-sample split with 120 train, 40 calibration, and 40 test samples per disturbance

criterion_c.label_boundary: criterion-C intervals are candidates, not expert-confirmed floods

result.reporting_status: TEP five-class real-data engineering validation; exact public payload with a locally registered P1 split, not a paper-score reproduction
limitations: The five-class payload has no normal-operation class.
Fault labels supervise AFC, while criterion-C intervals remain descriptive candidates.
